connections.connection: The Creator of the heavens and the earth is also the Savior who offers redemption through Jesus Christ.
Creation reveals God's power and wisdom, while the Gospel reveals His love and grace.
The heavens declare the glory of God, and the Gospel declares His mercy.
The order and beauty of creation point us toward the One who designed both the universe and the plan of salvation.
The God who created the world has also revealed the truth of salvation through His Son.
